name: Sparse Voxel DAG Ray Traversal
aliases: Ray tracing a sparse voxel DAG
definition: A GPU-based ray tracing method using CUDA to traverse a Sparse Voxel DAG for visibility queries (shadows, AO) and primary ray intersection.
summary: Sparse Voxel DAG Ray Traversal is a GPU method that traverses a Sparse Voxel Directed Acyclic Graph to perform visibility queries, differing from standard octrees by eliminating contour intersection tests and leveraging DAG structure for strict ray-order traversal.
